validation_tag_definitions.mechanistically accurate and clinically: Supported by clinical trial data and mechanistic understanding
validation_tag_definitions.mechanistically accurate only: Biologically plausible based on mechanism but lacks clinical validation
validation_tag_definitions.mechanistically rare: Possible but uncommon or unusual scenario
validation_tag_definitions.mechanistically not possible: Contradicts known biology or mechanism of action

sensitive_upregulation.description: Upregulation of the EGFR-RAS-ERK pathway indicates active signaling, which is targeted by adagrasib, leading to tumor growth inhibition in KRAS G12C mutant lung cancer.

sensitive_downregulation.description: Downregulation of the pathway may indicate compensatory mechanisms or alternative pathway activation, but residual KRAS G12C activity allows adagrasib to exert its effect.

resistant_upregulation.description: Despite upregulation, resistance may occur due to secondary mutations or bypass signaling pathways that negate adagrasib's effect.

resistant_downregulation.description: Downregulation suggests alternative oncogenic drivers are active, making the tumor less dependent on the KRAS pathway and resistant to adagrasib.

sensitive_upregulation.description: Adagrasib effectively inhibits KRAS G12C, leading to feedback upregulation of upstream signaling components as a compensatory response in sensitive tumors.

sensitive_downregulation.description: Successful inhibition of KRAS G12C by adagrasib results in downregulation of the EGFR-RAS-ERK pathway, correlating with tumor regression.

resistant_upregulation.description: Persistent upregulation post-treatment suggests activation of alternative pathways or resistance mechanisms that maintain pathway activity despite KRAS inhibition.

resistant_downregulation.description: Downregulation post-treatment in resistant tumors indicates pathway suppression but ineffective tumor control due to alternative survival pathways.

sensitive_upregulation.description: Upregulation of the PI3K/AKT/mTOR pathway may indicate a dependency on this signaling for tumor growth, making the tumor more susceptible to KRAS G12C inhibition by adagrasib, which indirectly affects this pathway.

sensitive_downregulation.description: Downregulation of the PI3K/AKT/mTOR pathway might suggest alternative survival pathways are active, yet the tumor remains sensitive to adagrasib due to its primary action on KRAS G12C.

resistant_upregulation.description: Upregulation of the PI3K/AKT/mTOR pathway could confer resistance to adagrasib if the pathway provides a bypass mechanism for KRAS G12C inhibition.

resistant_downregulation.description: Downregulation of the PI3K/AKT/mTOR pathway in resistant tumors suggests reliance on other pathways for survival, reducing adagrasib's efficacy.

sensitive_downregulation.description: Downregulation of the PI3K/AKT/mTOR pathway after treatment in sensitive tumors indicates effective pathway suppression and tumor response to adagrasib.

resistant_upregulation.description: In resistant tumors, continued upregulation suggests that the PI3K/AKT/mTOR pathway remains active despite KRAS G12C inhibition, contributing to resistance.

resistant_downregulation.description: Downregulation in resistant tumors post-treatment may indicate initial pathway inhibition, but other compensatory mechanisms maintain resistance.

resistant_upregulation.description: Continued upregulation post-treatment indicates failure of adagrasib to inhibit the pathway, possibly due to acquired resistance mechanisms.

resistant_downregulation.description: Downregulation in resistant tumors suggests pathway inhibition but lack of tumor response due to reliance on alternative survival pathways.

sensitive_upregulation.description: In lung cancer, upregulation of the cell cycle pathway indicates high proliferative activity, which may be driven by KRAS mutations. Adagrasib, a KRAS G12C inhibitor, can effectively target these mutations, leading to tumor sensitivity.

sensitive_downregulation.description: Downregulation of the cell cycle pathway in lung cancer may indicate a quiescent state or reliance on alternative pathways. Adagrasib can still be effective if KRAS G12C is present, as it specifically targets this oncogenic driver.

resistant_upregulation.description: Upregulation of the cell cycle pathway with resistance to adagrasib suggests alternative proliferative drivers or compensatory mechanisms bypassing KRAS inhibition.

resistant_downregulation.description: Downregulation of the cell cycle pathway with resistance to adagrasib may indicate reliance on non-KRAS pathways or adaptive resistance mechanisms.

resistant_downregulation.description: Downregulation of the cell cycle pathway in resistant tumors after adagrasib treatment may indicate temporary suppression but eventual adaptation or activation of bypass mechanisms.

resistant_upregulation.description: High baseline WNT/beta-catenin signaling may drive resistance by promoting survival pathways that counteract KRAS inhibition by adagrasib.

resistant_downregulation.description: Low WNT/beta-catenin signaling might indicate reliance on other pathways for survival, leading to resistance against KRAS inhibition by adagrasib.
